Connect.title: Connect the browser extension
Connect.intro: The {app} extension in this browser asks to save pages to your account, {email}.
Connect.token: This creates an access token named “{name}”, which you can revoke at any time in Settings → Access tokens.
Connect.onlyIfYouAsked: Connect only if you just clicked Connect in the extension’s options.
Connect.invalid: This address wasn’t opened by the {app} extension. To connect the extension, open its options and click Connect.
